target.name: Re:Build Manufacturing
target.founder: Miles Arnone, Jeff Wilke, Anthony Manzo, Michael Foley

methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $545M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 4 same-sector + same/adjacent-stage peers in Robotics & Manufacturing. Range: $1.1B - $2.0B.

data.narrative:
Re:Build Manufacturing is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company founded by Miles Arnone, Jeff Wilke, Anthony Manzo, and Michael Foley, having raised $545M+ to date. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of 9 private and 1 public comparable, including Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, Generalist AI, and Walden Robotics.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression to the $545M total raised proxy, implying a valuation of $1.1B. Peer-median valuation across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median of $1.7B, with a range spanning $1.1B (Walden Robotics, seed stage) to $2.0B (Generalist AI, Series B). The two methods converge on a triangulated range of $926M to $2.0B, with a median of $1.4B.

The analysis supports a valuation in the $1.1B to $1.7B band, anchored by stage-adjusted capital deployment and peer multiples. Key uncertainties include Re:Build's relative stage positioning within Series A, burn rate and capital efficiency versus the peer set, and technology differentiation that would justify positioning at the higher or lower end of the peer range. Additional diligence on revenue trajectory and customer concentration would sharpen the valuation point estimate.
